Enterprise Edition.note: Legacy webapp string 'Edizione squadra' exists for Team Edition, but edition names are product names; keep in English.

Team Edition.note: Legacy strings render this as 'Edizione squadra'/'Edizione Team'; as a product name it should stay in English.

Channels.note: Product name; do not confuse with the common noun 'canali'.

Calls.note: Product name; the common noun 'call' is 'chiamata'.

System Console.note: Established rendering in webapp it.json; keep capitalized as a named UI area.

marketplace.note: Kept in English in existing translations ('Attiva marketplace', 'URL marketplace'); masculine: 'il Marketplace'.

team.note: Majority rendering in webapp/server (285 occurrences vs 35 for kept 'team'); mobile occasionally keeps 'team' — prefer 'squadra' for consistency. Feminine; plural 'squadre'.

post.note: Established webapp/server rendering (~148 occurrences); mobile often renders 'post' as 'messaggio' since the UI treats them interchangeably. Feminine. Verb 'to post' = 'pubblicare'.

thread.note: Kept in English (majority across webapp/mobile/calls); masculine, invariable: 'il thread', 'i thread'. Some older strings use 'discussione' or 'conversazione' — avoid mixing.

direct message.note: Majority rendering; a few legacy strings use 'Messaggio Privato' — avoid. Sidebar heading 'Messaggi diretti'.

mention.note: Majority in webapp/server (42+ occurrences, zero 'menzione' there); newer mobile strings use 'menzione', which is the more standard modern Italian UI term (Slack/Teams) — flagged for possible future unification. Verb: 'citare'.

pin.note: Existing majority: 'Blocca al canale', 'Pubblicazioni bloccate', 'Sblocca dal canale' (unpin). Newer mobile strings use 'appuntare' ('Messaggi appuntati'), arguably clearer, but 'bloccare' is the established rendering.

bookmark.note: No existing signal (channel bookmarks untranslated in it.json); standard Italian UI term. Masculine; verb: 'aggiungere un segnalibro'.

saved messages.note: Majority rendering; legacy webapp strings use 'contrassegnato' ('Pubblicazioni contrassegnate') — avoid. Verb save = 'salvare', unsave = 'rimuovi dai salvati'.

draft.note: Untranslated in current it.json files; standard Italian term. Feminine; plural 'bozze'.

scheduled post.note: Untranslated in current it.json; 'programmato' matches standard Italian UI convention (e.g. Slack/Gmail 'invio programmato').

emoji.note: Invariable. Existing strings treat it as feminine ('un'emoji personalizzata') — use feminine consistently.

custom emoji.note: Feminine per existing usage; plural 'emoji personalizzate'.

reaction.note: Verb react = 'reagire' ('reagire alla pubblicazione' in existing strings).

do not disturb.note: Consistent existing rendering across webapp and mobile.

away.note: Majority rendering; scattered mobile variants ('Via', 'In trasferta', 'non al computer') should be avoided.

online.note: Webapp uses 'In Linea'; mobile sometimes keeps 'Online'. 'In linea' pairs with 'Non in linea' for offline.

offline.note: Webapp rendering, pairs with 'In linea'; mobile sometimes keeps 'Offline'.

out of office.note: Webapp majority; mobile uses 'Fuori ufficio' — prefer 'Fuori sede'.

guest.note: Majority rendering; one legacy string uses 'Visitatori'. Beware collision with Calls 'host' mistranslated as 'ospite' in some Calls strings.

system admin.note: Existing: 'Amministratore di Sistema' (capitalized as a role name in admin UI).

sign in.note: Button/imperative: 'Accedi'. Use for both 'sign in' and 'log in' per existing usage ('Accedi ad un altro Server').

sign out.note: Existing consistent rendering: 'Esci' for both Log Out and Sign Out. Alternative 'disconnettersi' appears rarely.

join.note: Existing: 'Unirsi', 'Ti sei unito alla squadra'; button form 'Unisciti'. Calls uses 'partecipare' for joining a call — keep that distinction.

mute.note: For channels: 'Silenzia canale', 'canale silenziato'. Avoid mobile variants 'Muto'/'disattivato'. Unmute = 'riattiva le notifiche' or 'rimuovi silenziamento' (existing mobile).

follow.note: 'Segui il thread', 'Stai seguendo' in existing strings.

unfollow.note: Button: 'Non seguire più'. Existing mobile renderings are inconsistent ('Thread da non seguire', 'Messaggio di esclusione') — avoid.

favorite.note: Noun/adjective 'preferito'; verb: 'aggiungere ai preferiti', unfavorite: 'rimuovi dai preferiti' (existing).

webhook.note: Kept in English per existing usage; masculine, invariable: 'il webhook', 'i webhook' (avoid legacy plural 'webhooks' in Italian text).

trigger word.note: Existing strings are inconsistent ('parole di innesco', 'parola chiave', 'parola di esecuzione'); 'parola di attivazione' avoids collision with keyword = 'parola chiave'.

plugin.note: Kept in English; masculine, invariable: 'il plugin', 'i plugin' (avoid legacy 'plugins' plural in Italian text).

bot.note: Kept in English; masculine, invariable. 'Account bot' = bot account (existing).

permission.note: Existing consistent: 'Permessi', 'Schemi di Permesso'. The alternative 'autorizzazione' is not used in this product.

scheme.note: Masculine: 'lo schema', 'gli schemi'; 'Schema di Sistema' = System Scheme (existing).

seat.note: No existing signal; standard Italian licensing term for per-user seats. Feminine; plural 'postazioni'.

trial.note: Majority rendering ('prova gratuita' for free trial); a couple of legacy strings keep 'trial' — avoid.

workspace.note: Majority rendering; one legacy string uses 'area di lavoro' — avoid.

subscription.note: Standard Italian SaaS term; the single existing string uses 'sottoscrizione', which is less idiomatic for recurring plans.

unread.note: 'Segna come non letto'; plural noun usage (unreads) = 'non letti' ('Filtra non letti').

recap.note: New AI feature, untranslated in it.json; 'riepilogo' aligns with Calls meeting summary = 'riepilogo della riunione'.

agent.note: Masculine; plural 'agenti'. The Agents product/feature name may stay 'Agents' when used as a proper name.

burn-on-read.note: New feature, no existing signal. Adjective use: 'messaggio con distruzione alla lettura'; label: 'DISTRUZIONE ALLA LETTURA'.

magic link.note: Slack's Italian rendering; 'magic link' kept in English is also common in Italian products — use one form consistently.

personal access token.note: Existing consistent rendering; 'token' is kept in English (masculine, invariable).

announcement banner.note: 'banner' kept in English (masculine, invariable) per existing usage ('Testo Banner', 'Colore Banner').

keyword.note: Existing consistent: 'Parole chiave che attivano le menzioni'.

user group.note: Plain 'gruppo' when context is clear (existing: 'Citazione gruppo').

permalink.note: No existing signal; standard Italian rendering.

profile.note: One legacy string maps Profile to 'Impostazioni Account' — avoid; use 'profilo'.

display name.note: Majority across desktop/mobile/webapp-notifications; a couple of legacy webapp strings use 'Nome visibile' — prefer 'nome visualizzato'.

collapsed reply threads.note: Existing mobile rendering; a duplicate string uses 'collassati' — prefer 'compressi'.

auto-translation.note: Label form for auto-translated messages: 'TRADOTTO AUTOMATICAMENTE'.

data retention.note: Existing consistent rendering in webapp/server ('Politica Ritenzione dei Dati'); 'conservazione dei dati' is the standard Italian/GDPR term and arguably better — kept 'ritenzione' for consistency.

compliance export.note: Legacy strings use 'Esportazione Conforme (Beta)', which misreads the English ('compliant export'); 'esportazione di conformità' is more accurate.

access control.note: No reliable existing signal (one legacy string relabels it 'Moderazione canale'); standard Italian security term. Policy: 'politica di controllo degli accessi'.

attribute.note: Masculine; plural 'attributi'. Existing: 'Attributo Nome Gruppo Visualizzato'.

onboarding.note: Commonly kept in English in Italian software; masculine: 'l'onboarding'.

Town Square.note: Existing server rendering of the default channel name.

Off-Topic.note: Existing server rendering of the default channel name (hyphenated to remain a valid channel name).

read-only.note: Existing: 'Questo canale è in sola lettura' (webapp); mobile uses 'di sola lettura' — either preposition works, prefer 'in sola lettura'.

server.note: Kept in English; masculine, invariable: 'il server', 'i server' (avoid legacy plural 'servers' in Italian text).
